integrity: A complete exact proof and standalone Python 3 finite verifier are supplied; exhaustive finite tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted Dyck paths, interior ground-level return coordinates only. Fine-number and Catalan enumeration are classical; only the all-sign Walsh spectral floor and its deconvolution interpretation are assessed as additional. Earlier unindexed identical inequalities are possible. No independent audit.
title: Fine-number spectral floor for Dyck-return convolution
